story_text: As a guest, I want to create a booking where check-in and check-out are the same date to be rejected so that same-day bookings are not allowed.

positive.title: Create booking with identical check-in and check-out dates
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with check-in and check-out dates set to the same value
positive.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message explicitly states same-day bookings are not allowed

positive.title: Create booking with check-out one day after check-in (minimum valid stay)
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with check-in and check-out dates set one day apart

negative.title: Create booking with check-out before check-in
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with check-out date before check-in date
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states check-out must be after check-in

negative.title: Create booking with check-in date in the past
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with check-in date in the past

negative.title: Create booking with dates in wrong format (dd-mm-yyyy instead of yyyy-mm-dd)
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with check-in and check-out dates set to the same value
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · format validation error, not a date-logic error

edge.title: Create booking with check-in = today (boundary — same-day arrival)
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with check-in date set to today
